decision_summary: Add an evaluation engineering block to the AI Builder curriculum.
rationale: High-confidence client demand for builders who can test, monitor, and explain agent behavior.
alternatives_considered: Add only an optional reading list

decision_summary: Add integration architecture evidence to Scaler credential requirements.
rationale: Clients need proof that Scalers can connect AI capabilities to production workflows and governance constraints.
alternatives_considered: Defer to next full credential version

decision_summary: Do not create a dedicated prompt library module yet; continue monitoring.
rationale: Signal is visible but lacks named commercial pull and may be absorbed into broader workflow design.
alternatives_considered: Deprecate prompt practices from current content

decision_summary: Add AI security and privacy checks to Scaler simulations.
rationale: Regulated clients are asking for clear evidence of data handling and risk controls.

decision_summary: Add multimodal prototype sprint to Prototyper learning pathway.
rationale: Recent client demand indicates that prototype portfolios need richer modalities than text-only workflows.
